key_insight: The classical communication cost of simulating quantum state transmission equals that of simulating prepare-and-broadcast quantum correlations and grows exponentially with quantum dimension.
engineering_relevance: Classical complexity offers a resource benchmark for quantum communication advantage and tools to certify quantum preparation devices.
method: Define minimum-cost classical communication models for quantum preparations.
Prove resource equivalence with prepare-and-broadcast correlation simulation.
Certify complexity using semidefinite programming, analytical witnesses and scalable convex programming.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical scaling exponential in quantum dimension and power-law in inverse noise, plus convex-programming methods handling hundreds and sometimes thousands of qubit states.
watch_item: The abstract does not report hardware validation, and practical certification costs may depend on the preparation set and optimization method.
paper_title: The classical complexity of quantum state transmission
